notes.subject: David i tok long Elohim
notes.rationale: Tok bilong pe i go stret long Elohim bilong em.

notes.subject: תשגבני
notes.rationale: שגב em i 'mekim i stap antap, i no inap kisim' — 'salim mi go long ples klia' i holim piksa bilong strong.

translation: Rausim mi long ol birua bilong mi, Elohim bilong mi; long ol man i sanapn long mi, yu ken salim mi go long ples klia.
